                "reviewer_name": "Tammy",
                "comments": "We live near Portland, Oregon in the USA and it prides itself on being hip and weird. Bondi Beach must be its sister city times two. We had a minivan that was simply too big to allow for pedestrians pushing baby strollers to get by. Parking on the street is for two hours only and the nearest long-term free parking is s few blocks away.                 "comments": "Le logement est parfait pour 2 familles, nous étions 2 couples avec 4 enfants et l'espace était assez grand pour tout le monde et bien pensé (1 chambre en bungalow en extérieur avec douche/toilette).\nLe logement était propre (intérieur/extérieur), tout était prêt pour notre arrivée (hiver à Sydney) couettes sur les lits, bouillottes, radiateurs à disposition et la cheminée feu de bois ! génial !                 "reviewer_name": "Jacob",
                "comments": "This house was a perfect rental for the week for me and my buddy. Both of us were from out of state (CA and FL) and attending a wedding nearby.                 "reviewer_name": "Ashley",
                "comments": "Overall I'd give Tom's house 4 out of 5 stars! Tom was incredibly easy to work with and very responsive to any questions we had! So as an upstairs guest there is no access to the backyard or the water front. The property is also located right on a semi-busy road so there was traffic and noise throughout the day and night. The road was convenient though. Quick access to Hamakua and to Kalanianaole hwy. The property had two large bedrooms, both with comfortable King sized Temperpedic mattresses. The bedding was comfortable as well. Each bedroom, as well as the living room, had air conditioning units. We used the bedroom units at night only, and were very comfortable and it drowned out the noise from the street (when there was noise). The overall cleanliness of the house was adequate but not impressive. It wasn't dirty but there were remnants of the last tenants - like hair. It wasn't unmanageable but not fun to deal with. One shower was pretty molded but we didn't even use that shower so it wasnt a problem. Of course we came across ants in the bathrooms but it didn't bother us a bit. As former residents of Kailua, we knew that ants are just part of the territory. We simply made sure to keep food in air tight containers or in the fridge.                 "reviewer_name": "David",
                "comments": "Royal Kuhio suite was a great affordable place to stay just outside of the over crowded streets of Waikiki but easily walking distance to everything you need.                 "comments": "PROS\nLocation: very close to restaurants, shops, a grocery store, public transport and most importantly the beach.\n\nView: has a great view of the city (apartment is on the 34th floor). \n\nHost: the host was very helpful and responsive.                 "listing_id": "1155475",
                "reviewer_id": "2954432",
                "reviewer_name": "Jake",
                "comments": "I stayed with Jon during a Christmas reunion with my family (one couple from Seattle, one from Texas, and my wife and I visiting from Amsterdam). First, Jon's house is in an excellent location- there is plenty to do within walking distance (grocery stores, restaurants, and even the Barclay's center), plus the connection to public transport is outstanding- there are a few stops within a 5-10min walk, leaving you with tons of local / express train options. We traveled to Manhattan every day and never spent more than 30min on the train. Additionally, the house is huge and never felt small with six of us there. The kitchen is big enouch to cook a modest meal, and the dining / living rooms are perfect places for larger groups to reconnect after a day of activities. There's also two full bathrooms, so just a tiny bit of planning prevents any bathroom scheduling conflics.\n\nThe main thing that keeps this from being a perfect rental is the sleeping arrangements- there is really only one real bed suitable for two people. There's a second queen bed in the listing that can accommodate two people, but it's only a sofa-bed in the 2nd floor study (separated from the main bedroom by a curtain). The 3rd and 4th bedrooms on the 3rd floor have twin beds which, though more comfortable than the sofa-bed, will always feel like two separate beds even when pushed together. Families or groups with people desiring individual beds will be fine here (the top two bedrooms would be perfect for a few kids or friends bunking together to save money), but you if your party has more than one couple, you might consider other options.\n\nAll things considered, this property is a pretty good value- it's a huge place that can accommodate many people, and it's in a perfect location. However, if I were to return for a similar trip, I'd only consider a return visit if at least one more queen+ bed was added."

                "reviewer_name": "Philippe",
                "comments": "The house is SPACIOUS and PERFECTLY LOCATED (walking distance to the B and 4-5 lines which take you all over Manhattan in a few minutes... and more lines). Fort Greene is a also a great neighborhood itself with lots of shopping options, the park and the BAM. The house itself is very nice, arranged over three floors with a large yard on a quite street. Check in was completely painless and Jon was super responsive when we had an issue with internet.\nOverall it's a great house and a unique experience to pretend to live in such a coveted neighborhood. However, I ended up paying about 800 per nigh because it was the holiday season and I am going to write a review based on this price. \nThere are a few things that COULD BE IMPROVED though.                 "reviewer_name": "Courtney",
                "comments": "Shangri'La is a great getaway from hectic everyday lives and typical busy tourist areas.                 "date": "2017-04-15T04:00:00.000Z",

                "reviewer_id": "2812727",
                "reviewer_name": "Dennis",
                "comments": "Shangri La is definitely a unique home but it has its drawbacks and is ideally suited for a certain type and size of family.  First the positives.  The lagoon is great for kids aged 5-10 who are new to snorkeling and its always fun for them to feed the fish everyday.  The landscaped grounds, beds, lines, bathrooms and laundry room are well appointed for this type of rental.  The property manager is very helpful as well.  Now the negatives.  First, the house has a strange layout with too many doors which makes it somewhat annoying to move around.  The two primary bedrooms are connected by a short hallway and so I would recommend against anyone hoping for privacy (like two couples).  Speaking of rooms, the unique island room is VERY exposed so whoever stays there must be comfortable with that (like a child).  The last room (called guest house) is also a ways from the master so families expecting young children to stay there, be careful.  As mentioned in some of the other reviews there are bugs here, and lots of them.  My kids were ravaged by mosquitoes and the kitchen was overrun by ants if you left even a crumb out.  You should also fully understand where the house is on the island relative to your intended primary activities.  You are far from the ideal snorkeling and water activities of Kona and the volcano crater is an hour away itself.  Lastly,  while the owner is very nice and communicative, he suffers from exaggeration.  For example, to say there are \"thousands\" of fish in the lagoon is outrageous.  And the local snorkeling is nothing like the Kona side.  And the couch shouldnt be considered a bed when its not even a pullout.  And don't think there is true \"access to the ocean\" - you can peak at it from someone's yard basically or walk a few blocks to a path.  Overall this is again a unique property and we enjoyed our stay for the most part, but we are adventurous.  We had 2 adults and 4 kids.  I wouldn't go above 4-5 ideally.  Happy to answer any questions objectively if you contact me.  "

            {

                "listing_id": "13743786",
                "reviewer_id": "95780411",
                "reviewer_name": "Timothy",
                "comments": "Our stay included sharing the place between two couples. Everyone loved it. We would definitely stay here again as the value was great. \r\n\r\nThe view was great. Check in was easy and only spoke with the host once. As mentioned in other reviews, the place does tend to get hot. For us, it wasn't too bad since the weather was cooler. Sergey did say we could park in the driveway, but I did not want to block other occupants of the house (This listing is for the top unit). \r\n\r\nThe apartment did have 4 beds although only one of the rooms wouldn't be considered private. You had to access one of the bedrooms through a den type room (listed as a bedroom). Not a problem for us, but keep it in mind if you are expecting 4 private bedrooms. The living room is also listed as a bedroom, however it does have a door to make it private. To get to the balcony, you will need to go through the living room. \r\n\r\nThe amenities were good. The free wifi was great and I was able to get 100Mbps down and 100Mbps up on a speed test. Unfortunately, the wifi signal did not reach to the kitchen (this could be a device issue). 4 towels were provided (we had 4 guests) along with 2 rolls of toilet paper. The dishes were minimal, but were adequate. We had 3 bowls and about the same amount of plates. Silverware wasn't an issue. There are no hangers listed in the amenities, but plastic store type hangers are provided and were appreciated. We did not use the tv as we mainly used the place as a sleeping place and then took the ferry to the city. \r\n\r\nWe drove our car to the garage located on Central Avenue (next to the Staten Island Criminal Court) and walked to the ferry terminal . Cost was $8/day but it does close at midnight. Ferry did take about a 30 minute ride to the city, but was a fun way to get there.\r\n\r\nThe neighborhood isn't that fancy or new, but we did feel comfortable and safe. Look beyond the buildings and you will see that this is a middle income neighborhood. Expect real New York and not the 1% neighborhoods. (I only mention this because 1 other review mentioned the neighborhood not being the greatest). "

                "comments": "I’m not sure I know enough positive words to fully describe how amazing Wayne, Kim, and their home was for our family vacation.                 "comments": "This is a roomy condo in a good location with spectacular views of the ocean and the mountains. We had a great time! The condo is clean and well-appointed.                 "reviewer_name": "Victoria",
                "comments": "El apartamento de Ana es un apartamento muy comodo en una zona de categoria como Ipanema a una cuadra de la playa. Es un apartamento en una zona accesible cerca de supermercados, restaurantes que posibilitan una estadía en familia por periodos prolongados. Sin embargo, el apartamento carece de algunos elementos como cubiertos, vasos suficientes y en condiciones como se describe en el anuncio supuestamente para  ocho personas. Pequeños elementos que no implicarian gran costo para el dueño. Por otro lado, el tema de la limpieza si bien no está sucio podría mejorarse sobretodo abajo de las camas y ropa de cama."
            },
            {
                "_id": "195504086",

                "reviewer_id": "106710998",
                "reviewer_name": "Mateus",
                "comments": "Um ótimo apartamento, uma localização excelente, próximo a restaurantes, supermercado, farmácias, banco, praia. Tranquilo de andar pelas ruas, além disso, tem transporte público bem perto. Recomendo a todos."
            },
            {
                "_id": "232591341",
                "date": "2018-02-05T05:00:00.000Z",
                "listing_id": "14741201",
                "reviewer_id": "3659520",
                "reviewer_name": "Andrés",
                "comments": "El departamento de Ana tiene una muy buena ubicación. Es amplio, cómodo, luminoso, en especial el living. Se encuentra intermediado por una empresa de alquileres temporarios (Ipanema Flats), Ana responde las consultas rápidamente, pero el contacto directo es a través de un encargado. Al llegar, uno de los aires acondicionados no funcionaba, se lo hicimos saber al encargado que inicialmente no reconoció ese desperfecto. Le escribimos a Ana y al otro día, el aire fue reemplazado satisfactoriamente y no tuvimos más problemas. En general, el departamento se encuentra en buenas condiciones, aunque tiene detalles que podrían mejorarse: el baño se encuentra -en relación con la foto de referencia- ya algo desgastado por el uso (en el piso, el mueble y los azulejos de la bañera), sería deseable una mejor disponibilidad en cuanto a la vajilla y utensilios de cocina; una de las puertas de un dormitorio no cierra bien y en el otro, hay un arreglo en la pared que no tiene pintura. La televisión y WIFI funcionaron sin problemas (aunque en una de las fotos figura una televisión en el dormitorio y eso no es así, se encuentra en el comedor). El edificio aunque antiguo se encuentra en muy buen estado y la atención de los porteros es impecable y siempre muy solícitos. Más allá de todos estos detalles, nuestra estadía fue confortable y cumplió con el objetivo de descanso, cubriendo nuestras expectativas, en especial debido a la ubicación del departamento, a camino entre las playas de Copacabana e Ipanema, con todo tipo de negocios disponibles, en un barrio tranquilo y agradable."
            },

                "reviewer_name": "Hazelle",
                "comments": "“Wow” is probably the best word I can think to describe this incredible place. The photos just don’t do it justice. Finished with impeccable taste, this place is definitely a gem.  Located on the best part of Mackeral beach, and surrounded by wildlife - including a resident wallaby who comes so close you can feed him by hand! The water as crystal clear as Thailand and just a two seconds away, down a very well paved and not too steep path. The views from the house and tree house are beyond breathtaking and the owner is super nice and attentive. Upon arrival he sent a message to see if we got in OK and during the booking phase he responded immediately to our questions. The BBQ is state of the ark (very important!) and the place is totally set up for entertaining with a great coffee machine, two fridges, plenty of cutlery, glasses, plates etc ... . Everything has been thought of, from hats and repellant to hooks to hang out your wet beach towels. We will definitely be back. Everyone who stopped by to visit us while we were there will be booking too, so I just hope we can get in! Thank you Richard. You have created a little slice of heaven. "
            },
            {
                "_id": "10075406",
                "date": "2014-01-28T05:00:00.000Z",
                "listing_id": "1714235",
                "reviewer_id": "11593219",
                "reviewer_name": "Julian",
                "comments": "If you are seeking a charmingly rustic, secluded getaway to a cottage located twenty metres from a stunning protected beach; look no further.\r\n\r\nGetting to the house is a boating adventure directly from Palm Beach (either by the ferry, the friendly local boat house, or the water taxi). Not being able to drive to the house is a nice removal from the mundane, however make sure you pack accordingly.\r\n\r\nThe main sandstone cottage is designed to effortlessly entertain large or small groups of people. The generous outdoor setting is nicely accompanied by extra deck chairs and umbrellas.\r\n\r\nRichard and Claudia have very tastefully arranged the homely living interiors and bedrooms. The tree-house (bedroom and bathroom), removed from the main cottage, is fantastic and you are treated to a stunning elevated view to the East. Watching sunrise over the ocean from the comfort of  bed is pretty special.\r\n\r\nThe quiet location means sleeping with the doors open to the sound of gentle waves is a must, and the house is well stocked with mosquito coils to make the pests don't interrupt.\r\n\r\nThe recently renovated kitchen contains everything needed for cooking, and is complemented by the large BBQ outside.\r\n\r\nThere are walking trails nearby which can take you to the West Head lookout, Aboriginal Archaeological sites, and tiny beaches dotted around the headland.\r\n\r\nAll-in-all, a very pleasant stay, and we look forward to any opportunity to return."
            },

                "comments": "Richard's cottage is definitely an even better experience than the pictures suggest, very scenic views and lots of comfort.                 "comments": "Let's start with the positives - this house was in a great location, close to pubs, restaurants, shops and amenities. And the beds were comfy. The four bedrooms felt grimy; only three had doors, the fourth wide open at the top of a staircase - far from ideal. The towels were threadbare. Plus, with 8 of staying, I would expect at least 8 of everything: cutlery, wine glasses, plates, water glasses, mugs - there were not. The spare keys were not where they should have been. Jeremy showed up the following day with flowers as an apology and spare keys - but we had no vase to put the flowers in. This house COULD be great - it has the space for 8, two lovely balconies, comfy beds, great location.                 "comments": "We spend 5 nights from 24 - 29 Aug at Mehmet's place.                 "comments": "Three friends and I went to visit a friend in Istanbul for a week. We stayed in Mehmet’s flat for the 6 nights and thoroughly enjoyed it.                 "reviewer_id": "911152",
                "reviewer_name": "Jonathan",
                "comments": "This is an excellent apartment/flat for small families or two couples.  This place is much larger then the photos make it look.  Each bedroom has a queen sized bed and there is room for a Pack N Play/Camping bed for a small child in either bedroom.  The master bedroom has it's own full bathroom.  \nThe view from the 4th floor is stunning at Sunset and it is a quiet neighborhood at night.  Parking is free out front or Isabel has 1 free parking spot in the underground parking area.  \nThere is a grocery store on the street level of the apartment building or you can walk/drive to the Jumbo which is not far away.  \nThe beach is a little far to walk to, but it can be done or a 5 minute drive will get you there.  Parking is free on either side of the main beach road.  This is where you will find restaurants, bars, many kilometers of bike/walking path, and for those with children there are play areas designed for them.  \nThe best part of this place is that it is only a 12 minute drive to parking areas where you can walk onto a bridge that will take you into the center of Porto.                 "reviewer_id": "19750852",
                "reviewer_name": "Aaron",
                "comments": "Our Porto stay at Jorge/Rui’s place was positive.  The location was spectacular, close to many amenities and walkable to the city center.  There was a lot of good recommendations given by our host and he marked up our map loaded with things to do.  While the location was great, we needed to switch places because the top level apartment was full of sewer odors coming from all the plumbing fixtures.  It was difficult to spend time in the apartment.  We called the “Feel Porto” agency and disclosed our situation.  They thought they could hide the smell with candles, but they soon realized this was a much larger building problem.  They ended up switching our apartment to the 1st floor apartment in the same building which was wonderful and did not have any odors.  The place was spacious, strong wifi, cable tv, and great heater.  The beds were comfortable and clean.  \n\nMy recommendation would be to reserve the 1st floor apartment only until they correct the plumbing issues on the 5th floor.  Nothing extremely negative about “Feel Porto” agency, they were professional and responsive.  However, I don’t think they should have rented the 5th floor apartment to begin with and we needed to interrupt our day to switch places.  They certainly were apologetic and acknowledged they would make required repairs."

                "reviewer_name": "Sandra",
                "comments": "Stayed in several places in Hong Kong before. This is our favorite so far. I read hundreds of reviews before choosing this place.                 "comments": "I am so happy I booked my stay here for my boyfriend and I while we were in town for a wedding. The house was so beautiful and fully renovated.             {
                "_id": "51526003",
                "date": "2015-10-21T04:00:00.000Z",
                "listing_id": "5262710",
                "reviewer_id": "37479739",
                "reviewer_name": "John",
                "comments": "Nestled on a quiet cul-de-sac in the laid-back Hawaiian town of Kailua, Tutu’s Hale delivers as a peaceful respite on the oft-overlooked windward (or east) side of Oahu.  Short story: My wife and I traveled to Oahu 10 years ago.  We stayed in a hotel on Waikiki Beach, we largely kept to Honolulu (beaches, shopping, restaurants, etc.), we spent a lot of money, and had a miserable time.  We were determined this time to really experience all that Oahu had to offer, and generally avoid the heavy tourist areas.  Instead of the traffic and headaches of Honolulu, we opted to stay in Kailua – which turned out to be a great decision.  If you are concerned that Kailua may be too far from the action of Honolulu, don’t worry.  With the Pali Highway (Route 61), Route 72, and H3, we found ourselves only a scenic 30-minute drive from downtown Honolulu, Diamond Head, Hanauma Bay, Pearl Harbor, or the junction to North Shore.  If you don’t believe me, check out these images – this is your drive every day! (Website hidden by Airbnb) \r\n\r\nThe house we stayed in was a spacious 3-bedroom, 2-bath with a massive kitchen (the owner said there’s even a 4th bedroom if you need it, for just a little more). “Fully furnished” does not quite describe the attention to detail and valuable extras that are provided.  Snorkeling gear (check!), boogie boards (check!), ice coolers (check!), washer/dryer (check!), as well as tons of kitchenware, a massive gas grill under the carport, and more. We saved a lot of money on gear we didn’t need to rent, and saved time not having to make that extra trip to the store for “essentials.”  A flat-screen TV, Apple TV, and a nice wi-fi setup bring this vintage Hawaiian home into the digital age.  There are some great restaurants (4-star or better on Yelp, Saigon Noodle House was one of our favorites - (Website hidden by Airbnb) just a mile away in a nearby shopping center, or in downtown Kailua.  Kailua Beach and Lanakai Beach are just a short drive away, and quickly became our favorite beaches of the trip.  We got way more for our money in Kailua, and truly felt like we had been to Oahu for the first time.\r\n\r\nBottom line: If you want to sip umbrella drinks on Wakiki Beach, with a short walk back to an overpriced, tiny condo, this is not the place for you.  But if you want to feel like you are truly living in Hawaii, and experience the island from the perspective of a multi-generational Hawaiian family (the photos are right on the walls!) – with all the modern perks you would expect, I highly recommend this property."

                "comments": "While the description does say that the house does not have AC, the tradewinds that supposedly cool down the house did not do their job during our stay.                 "reviewer_id": "52423874",
                "reviewer_name": "John",
                "comments": "We (6 middle-aged couples) were in Villa C1 at Waikaloa Beach Villas for 14 days  - a great villa at this complex  in all respects. Loved it. We went to celebrate retirements, birthdays, relax and enjoy each others company and this complex provided us such an ideal opportunity to do so compared to the often crowded hotel resorts. This C1 villa has absolutely everything you need including heaps of beach gear in garage. We didn't want to spend $'s eating out each night and the really well appointed kitchen and BBQ allowed us to cook our own meals when we wished.  C1 is 10 metres from one of the the complexes 2 pools. Queens Market Place over road and Kings up the road, golf clubs in walking distance and ample walking opportunities. The community is compact from the Waikaloa Villas at one end to the Hilton Resort at  the other. The WBV's provide a pass to the Hilton to use their pools- we used and just well worth having a look at this complex complete with its own monorail!! We had a rental to do some day touring and beach visits. While there is a food store at Queen's its expensive so a short drive (15 mins) to the larger store at Waikoloa Village well worth it. Eat out options average at Queens and the nearby Kings Market Places, but we found Sansei Seafood, Steak and Sushi Bar at Queens superb - but you need to book. Most bars have happy hour (50% on beers and house wines from 3-6). We found beach front Lava Lava Beach Club by far the best here for ambiance, drinks and food-try the pulled pork sliders! and the marvellous sunset too and turtles came ashore  for the night. Hapuna Beach the best but need to take own chairs and umbrellas (from the garage). We did an 11 hour day trip with tour company to other side of island to see the volcanoes - much of the flora and fauna shown we have in NZ  but the lava glow/aura we saw at night was stunning. Trip was expensive but included a lunch and seated dinner - value for money ?? but we went to see the volcanoes and weren't disappointed.  Discount available if you want to sit through a Hilton presentation (no thanks).\nWe've been fortunate to travel worldly. In terms of relaxation this was the best. Two weeks without rain and 29-32 deg temps - heaven!   We're already planning a return in 2018! Just leave us a 10 day window please!"

                "comments": "Stelian & Deanna's place is a wonderful and spacious house! It's totally equipped, rooms are huge, the main bathroom is also fantastic.                 "listing_id": "921585",
                "reviewer_id": "5303606",
                "reviewer_name": "Shakuntala",
                "comments": "Great experience. The house is just as beautiful as it looks in the pictures, and has everything you need for a very comfortable stay. Lots of space, enough for our group of five adults. Two bathrooms, which is an absolute plus, if you are staying with more than two people. Lots of parking space in front of the house, if you arrive by car.\nBars and restaurants are right around the corner, make sure to check out „Zaka“ for great breakfast, lunch or dinner, just across the street on Garvey boulevard, which opened the week before we arrived. Check in was smooth and easy, check out very generous, as we were allowed to keep our luggage in the house, until we had to go to the airport.\nIt was a perfect stay, highly recommendable, would definitely return, if we came to NYC again.\n"

                "reviewer_name": "Sabrina",
                "comments": "La casa di Stelian & Deanna è davvero bella e accogliente. Spazi ampi, doppi servizi, lenzuola e asciugamani per ogni ospite. Le camere sono ampie e confortevoli.                 "reviewer_name": "Tammy",
                "comments": "We live near Portland, Oregon in the USA and it prides itself on being hip and weird. Bondi Beach must be its sister city times two. Parking on the street is for two hours only and the nearest long-term free parking is s few blocks away.                 "reviewer_name": "Jacob",
                "comments": "This house was a perfect rental for the week for me and my buddy. Both of us were from out of state (CA and FL) and attending a wedding nearby.                 "reviewer_id": "5754378",
                "reviewer_name": "David",
                "comments": "Royal Kuhio suite was a great affordable place to stay just outside of the over crowded streets of Waikiki but easily walking distance to everything you need. On the other side ala wai river is great to walk in the morning during sunrise.\n\nThe only downsides were as such, both out of Rogers control:\nWaikiki has roaches everywhere, No avoiding them, and you will spot a few smaller ones in the kitchen early in the morning but they're small and harmless. There's no treadmill but this can easily be remedied by heading outside before sunrise and running up ala wai towards diamond head, pay the $1 walk in admission and jog up to the top of diamond head to watch the sunrise, then jog back to the hotel for bfast. (Pro-tip for diamond head, at the top go right up the endless staircase then continue up the spiral staircase to come out in a bunker and climb out onto the path to see the sun.                 "comments": "PROS\nLocation: very close to restaurants, shops, a grocery store, public transport and most importantly the beach.\n\nView: has a great view of the city (apartment is on the 34th floor). \n\nHost: the host was very helpful and responsive.                 "listing_id": "1155475",
                "reviewer_id": "2954432",
                "reviewer_name": "Jake",
                "comments": "I stayed with Jon during a Christmas reunion with my family (one couple from Seattle, one from Texas, and my wife and I visiting from Amsterdam). First, Jon's house is in an excellent location- there is plenty to do within walking distance (grocery stores, restaurants, and even the Barclay's center), plus the connection to public transport is outstanding- there are a few stops within a 5-10min walk, leaving you with tons of local / express train options. We traveled to Manhattan every day and never spent more than 30min on the train. Additionally, the house is huge and never felt small with six of us there. The kitchen is big enouch to cook a modest meal, and the dining / living rooms are perfect places for larger groups to reconnect after a day of activities. There's also two full bathrooms, so just a tiny bit of planning prevents any bathroom scheduling conflics.\n\nThe main thing that keeps this from being a perfect rental is the sleeping arrangements- there is really only one real bed suitable for two people. There's a second queen bed in the listing that can accommodate two people, but it's only a sofa-bed in the 2nd floor study (separated from the main bedroom by a curtain). The 3rd and 4th bedrooms on the 3rd floor have twin beds which, though more comfortable than the sofa-bed, will always feel like two separate beds even when pushed together. Families or groups with people desiring individual beds will be fine here (the top two bedrooms would be perfect for a few kids or friends bunking together to save money), but you if your party has more than one couple, you might consider other options.\n\nAll things considered, this property is a pretty good value- it's a huge place that can accommodate many people, and it's in a perfect location. However, if I were to return for a similar trip, I'd only consider a return visit if at least one more queen+ bed was added."

                "reviewer_name": "Philippe",
                "comments": "The house is SPACIOUS and PERFECTLY LOCATED (walking distance to the B and 4-5 lines which take you all over Manhattan in a few minutes... and more lines). Fort Greene is a also a great neighborhood itself with lots of shopping options, the park and the BAM. The house itself is very nice, arranged over three floors with a large yard on a quite street. Check in was completely painless and Jon was super responsive when we had an issue with internet.\nOverall it's a great house and a unique experience to pretend to live in such a coveted neighborhood. However, I ended up paying about 800 per nigh because it was the holiday season and I am going to write a review based on this price. \nThere are a few things that COULD BE IMPROVED though. First, I somehow convinced that this would be a house in which Jon lives but this is not his primary residence. As a result, the house feels like a rental with older furniture and rather empty (plates and most cups are made of plastic for example, and I doubt anyone would live like that). \nApart from salt and a few spices, it was hard to find something to cook with so we had to buy pretty much everything to make French Toasts in the morning for the kids. It would have even nice to find sugar or syrup for example. Other than that, the kitchen is rather well equipped with pans and a nice gas range.\nFinally, my main sore point is about comfort. Were were two adult couples and two young kids. Kids slept very well and had basically all of the third floor for themselves, including a private bath with a tub. This was great!! The master bedroom was spacious and quiet and the bed was ok. However, the second bedroom was not so comfortable and rather small. Two nights were probably the most we could take in it. The bathroom is great though: excellent water pressure, hot water for everyone.\nAlso, as we were about to check in, Jon let us know that the washer was broken. This was of course not a problem but I believe that it had prevented the cleaning person to wash the linens, which smelled like someone else had slept in them. The towels also smelled moldy.                 "reviewer_name": "Courtney",
                "comments": "Shangri'La is a great getaway from hectic everyday lives and typical busy tourist areas. It took a while for us to get acclimated to the heat and humidity, but we were dealing with it like champs by the last day. Beds were comfortable and the kitchen was great for cooking meals. Our favorite part was the master outdoor shower; it was fun to shower under the blue skies or stars, along with geckos and coqui frogs! We struggled a little bit with mosquitoes and gnats, but that's really just a part of being mostly outdoors. The round house was great for relaxing and working (yes, sometimes we had to). I liked sitting on the bridge in the mornings to drink my morning coffee with the fishes. We went on a lava boat tour which was unforgettable and highly recommended if you don't mind rough seas. We also enjoyed soaking in the pools at Ahalanui Beach, a short drive away. Thanks for the great stay!"

            {
                "_id": "144396734",
                "date": "2017-04-15T04:00:00.000Z",
                "listing_id": "12507567",
                "reviewer_id": "2812727",
                "reviewer_name": "Dennis",
                "comments": "Shangri La is definitely a unique home but it has its drawbacks and is ideally suited for a certain type and size of family.  First the positives.  The lagoon is great for kids aged 5-10 who are new to snorkeling and its always fun for them to feed the fish everyday.  The landscaped grounds, beds, lines, bathrooms and laundry room are well appointed for this type of rental.  The property manager is very helpful as well.  Now the negatives.  First, the house has a strange layout with too many doors which makes it somewhat annoying to move around.  The two primary bedrooms are connected by a short hallway and so I would recommend against anyone hoping for privacy (like two couples).  Speaking of rooms, the unique island room is VERY exposed so whoever stays there must be comfortable with that (like a child).  The last room (called guest house) is also a ways from the master so families expecting young children to stay there, be careful.  As mentioned in some of the other reviews there are bugs here, and lots of them.  My kids were ravaged by mosquitoes and the kitchen was overrun by ants if you left even a crumb out.  You should also fully understand where the house is on the island relative to your intended primary activities.  You are far from the ideal snorkeling and water activities of Kona and the volcano crater is an hour away itself.  Lastly,  while the owner is very nice and communicative, he suffers from exaggeration.  For example, to say there are \"thousands\" of fish in the lagoon is outrageous.  And the local snorkeling is nothing like the Kona side.  And the couch shouldnt be considered a bed when its not even a pullout.  And don't think there is true \"access to the ocean\" - you can peak at it from someone's yard basically or walk a few blocks to a path.  Overall this is again a unique property and we enjoyed our stay for the most part, but we are adventurous.  We had 2 adults and 4 kids.  I wouldn't go above 4-5 ideally.  Happy to answer any questions objectively if you contact me.  "

            {

                "listing_id": "13743786",
                "reviewer_id": "95780411",
                "reviewer_name": "Timothy",
                "comments": "Our stay included sharing the place between two couples. Everyone loved it. We would definitely stay here again as the value was great. \r\n\r\nThe view was great. Check in was easy and only spoke with the host once. As mentioned in other reviews, the place does tend to get hot. For us, it wasn't too bad since the weather was cooler. Sergey did say we could park in the driveway, but I did not want to block other occupants of the house (This listing is for the top unit). \r\n\r\nThe apartment did have 4 beds although only one of the rooms wouldn't be considered private. You had to access one of the bedrooms through a den type room (listed as a bedroom). Not a problem for us, but keep it in mind if you are expecting 4 private bedrooms. The living room is also listed as a bedroom, however it does have a door to make it private. To get to the balcony, you will need to go through the living room. \r\n\r\nThe amenities were good. The free wifi was great and I was able to get 100Mbps down and 100Mbps up on a speed test. Unfortunately, the wifi signal did not reach to the kitchen (this could be a device issue). 4 towels were provided (we had 4 guests) along with 2 rolls of toilet paper. The dishes were minimal, but were adequate. We had 3 bowls and about the same amount of plates. Silverware wasn't an issue. There are no hangers listed in the amenities, but plastic store type hangers are provided and were appreciated. We did not use the tv as we mainly used the place as a sleeping place and then took the ferry to the city. \r\n\r\nWe drove our car to the garage located on Central Avenue (next to the Staten Island Criminal Court) and walked to the ferry terminal . Cost was $8/day but it does close at midnight. Ferry did take about a 30 minute ride to the city, but was a fun way to get there.\r\n\r\nThe neighborhood isn't that fancy or new, but we did feel comfortable and safe. Look beyond the buildings and you will see that this is a middle income neighborhood. Expect real New York and not the 1% neighborhoods. (I only mention this because 1 other review mentioned the neighborhood not being the greatest). "

                "comments": "We stayed for 8 days with our 2 adult children and their spouses and our one-year old grandson.                 "comments": "Wayne and Kim were both terrific hosts. Excellent communication and great attention to detail.                 "comments": "I’m not sure I know enough positive words to fully describe how amazing Wayne, Kim, and their home was for our family vacation.                 "comments": "Our trip to Kauai was a three-generation celebration, and our party of eight included two babies - one a year old and the other eight months.                 "reviewer_id": "3659520",
                "reviewer_name": "Andrés",
                "comments": "El departamento de Ana tiene una muy buena ubicación. Es amplio, cómodo, luminoso, en especial el living. Se encuentra intermediado por una empresa de alquileres temporarios (Ipanema Flats), Ana responde las consultas rápidamente, pero el contacto directo es a través de un encargado. Al llegar, uno de los aires acondicionados no funcionaba, se lo hicimos saber al encargado que inicialmente no reconoció ese desperfecto. Le escribimos a Ana y al otro día, el aire fue reemplazado satisfactoriamente y no tuvimos más problemas. En general, el departamento se encuentra en buenas condiciones, aunque tiene detalles que podrían mejorarse: el baño se encuentra -en relación con la foto de referencia- ya algo desgastado por el uso (en el piso, el mueble y los azulejos de la bañera), sería deseable una mejor disponibilidad en cuanto a la vajilla y utensilios de cocina; una de las puertas de un dormitorio no cierra bien y en el otro, hay un arreglo en la pared que no tiene pintura. La televisión y WIFI funcionaron sin problemas (aunque en una de las fotos figura una televisión en el dormitorio y eso no es así, se encuentra en el comedor). El edificio aunque antiguo se encuentra en muy buen estado y la atención de los porteros es impecable y siempre muy solícitos. Más allá de todos estos detalles, nuestra estadía fue confortable y cumplió con el objetivo de descanso, cubriendo nuestras expectativas, en especial debido a la ubicación del departamento, a camino entre las playas de Copacabana e Ipanema, con todo tipo de negocios disponibles, en un barrio tranquilo y agradable."

                "comments": "Nous avons vraiment apprécié notre séjour chez Sonia! L'appart était mieux que sur les photos.                 "comments": "This is a nice apartment in a good location but was still our first disappointment with an airbnb.  \nCheck-in was the first problem.                 "comments": "“Wow” is probably the best word I can think to describe this incredible place. The photos just don’t do it justice.                 "reviewer_name": "Julian",
                "comments": "If you are seeking a charmingly rustic, secluded getaway to a cottage located twenty metres from a stunning protected beach; look no further.\r\n\r\nGetting to the house is a boating adventure directly from Palm Beach (either by the ferry, the friendly local boat house, or the water taxi).                 "comments": "Our host made us feel very welcome!  The location was wonderful - right on the ocean. The waves lulled us to sleep when we turned off the air in just the master bedroom.                 "reviewer_name": "Adel",
                "comments": "We spend 5 nights from 24 - 29 Aug at Mehmet's place. What was more personal, was when he cared to check up on my brother the next day and asked how was keeping. \n\nWe also had an incident when unfortunately my wife's wallet was pickpocketed, and it contained the flat keys.             {
                "_id": "352300592",
                "date": "2018-11-25T05:00:00.000Z",
                "listing_id": "24296834",
                "reviewer_id": "225104207",
                "reviewer_name": "Jean",
                "comments": "Three friends and I went to visit a friend in Istanbul for a week. We stayed in Mehmet’s flat for the 6 nights and thoroughly enjoyed it. The flat  is very spacious and clean. The furniture is modern and comfortable, including the beds. The kitchen is fully functional and allows for home cooked meals. On top of this, the flat offers several amenities that really make it good value, these include: a roof terrace two floors above, balconies and a sit down shower! \nThe flat is equally very well located with several landmarks such as the Galata tower only a short walk away. The surrounding area is buzzing and necessities such as grocery stores and shops are very close by. My friends and I walked everywhere including to the old town without it ever being painfully long. \n\nAll in all,  I would recommend this flat to anyone coming to visit Istanbul and more. Mehmet is also exceptionally available and quick to respond, which turned out very practical."
            },

                "reviewer_id": "911152",
                "reviewer_name": "Jonathan",
                "comments": "This is an excellent apartment/flat for small families or two couples.  This place is much larger then the photos make it look.  Each bedroom has a queen sized bed and there is room for a Pack N Play/Camping bed for a small child in either bedroom.  The master bedroom has it's own full bathroom.  \nThe view from the 4th floor is stunning at Sunset and it is a quiet neighborhood at night.  Parking is free out front or Isabel has 1 free parking spot in the underground parking area.  \nThere is a grocery store on the street level of the apartment building or you can walk/drive to the Jumbo which is not far away.  \nThe beach is a little far to walk to, but it can be done or a 5 minute drive will get you there.  Parking is free on either side of the main beach road.  This is where you will find restaurants, bars, many kilometers of bike/walking path, and for those with children there are play areas designed for them.  \nThe best part of this place is that it is only a 12 minute drive to parking areas where you can walk onto a bridge that will take you into the center of Porto.                 "reviewer_name": "Phil",
                "comments": "Our 9-day stay at Robert's condo at Kona Coffee Villas was a treat. The place is very clean, modern, and has a panoramic view of the ocean. The condo seems to be in a safe and friendly neighborhood, and is very quiet at night, apart from the chorus of chirping frogs at dusk.                 "comments": "Our Porto stay at Jorge/Rui’s place was positive.  The location was spectacular, close to many amenities and walkable to the city center.                 "comments": "The Ohana House was comfortable and well appointed. The website photos and information represented the house accurately.                 "comments": "We had a wonderful stay at this beautiful rainforest home. Great location - close to the volcano and a quick drive to town.                 "reviewer_name": "Monica",
                "comments": "Its a very cozy place. You can stay here like a local. This house has a plenty of rooms for a big group. The town is small and many places closed early. Make sure you make a reservation if you want to eat at the restaurant or buy groceries in Hilo or Kona.\nThis place has a gas fireplace, heaters, dehumidifiers, washer, dryer, and full kitchen."
            },
            {
                "_id": "178136348",
                "date": "2017-08-04T04:00:00.000Z",
                "listing_id": "3121854",
                "reviewer_id": "70278332",
                "reviewer_name": "Annabel",
                "comments": "This is a very comfortable place to stay. The dehumidifiers are key as the location is in the rainforest and humidity is definitely there - the carpets can have a damp feel at times but this should be expected. \nThe condiments in the fridge and cupboard were very handy as we used the outdoor propane grill one night. The gas fireplace was handy - it does get cool in the evenings even in the summer. We loved the washer/dryer as it was a good size (not like those tiny ones you see stacked in a closet in other rental units).\nWe arrived after sun down so the road was a bit dark as is the whole neighborhood. Don't expect much in the form of street lights or visible street signs. Thank goodness for GPS and smart phone maps. The free wifi was handy as our cell phone carrier signals were weak. \nThe proximity to the entrance to Volcanoes National Park cannot be beat. It gave us an early start into the park and gave us a great place to stay the night after a full day there (including watching sunset from the Jagger Museum lookout).\nWe were very happy with our stay thanks to Becky and her accommodation. Thank you!"

Ted’s Bakery is just down the highway, about a 4 min. walk as well. We enjoyed numerous meals there and the food is top quality!  Nice to have that so close. We stayed on the top level of the house. It was nice to have a personal bedroom for each of the three of us. We definitely appreciated the space. Amenities are basic but what we needed. Food cannot be left out as the ants will come. There is no A/C. It is best to not be in the house from say noon till sundown as it will be quite hot. However, opening the windows and bringing in the evening air is sufficient (we stayed the first week of November.) The occasional rain showers also helped to mediate the heat inside. Roosters begin their morning chatter around 4:30 am. Earplugs are a must if you are used to a more quiet sleeping environment. We had a few leaks in the roof on a day when the rains were heavier. We just moved the sofa out of the drip line and all was fine. We drove a lot around the island and this home was a great starting place for our day trips. Would definitely recommend this home for a stay in the North Shore."

                "reviewer_id": "10681107",
                "reviewer_name": "Jamie",
                "comments": "Tane's place is an amazing respite from typical Hawaiian tourist fare. You are located up from the belt road, so it's a bit cooler, and bugs are not at all an issue. The place ranks on the farm house side. Its layout is incredible and feels a bit like three hales combined into one. Ceiling fans keep you cool, if needed. The kitchen is ample and Tane makes sure you have enough of everything (linens, paper products, water) so that you are completely self-sufficient. He supplied us with complimentary coffee, cinnamon (both amazingly good--we bought 2 more lbs of coffee), oranges, bananas, and strawberries upon arrival. A silent but super hospitable and responsive host. Some other notes: You probably won't want to leave the screened lanai with hot tub (we didn't use the hot tub, mainly because we were fairly warm throughout our stay, but we thought about it every night); if you are a light sleeper, bring earplugs to silence out the ubiquitous frogs who sing throughout the night; drive carefully along the narrow paved road to the property--most of the people living around are locals and also are farmers.                 "reviewer_id": "37479739",
                "reviewer_name": "John",
                "comments": "Nestled on a quiet cul-de-sac in the laid-back Hawaiian town of Kailua, Tutu’s Hale delivers as a peaceful respite on the oft-overlooked windward (or east) side of Oahu.  Short story: My wife and I traveled to Oahu 10 years ago.  We stayed in a hotel on Waikiki Beach, we largely kept to Honolulu (beaches, shopping, restaurants, etc.), we spent a lot of money, and had a miserable time.  We were determined this time to really experience all that Oahu had to offer, and generally avoid the heavy tourist areas.  Instead of the traffic and headaches of Honolulu, we opted to stay in Kailua – which turned out to be a great decision.  If you are concerned that Kailua may be too far from the action of Honolulu, don’t worry.  With the Pali Highway (Route 61), Route 72, and H3, we found ourselves only a scenic 30-minute drive from downtown Honolulu, Diamond Head, Hanauma Bay, Pearl Harbor, or the junction to North Shore.  If you don’t believe me, check out these images – this is your drive every day! (Website hidden by Airbnb) \r\n\r\nThe house we stayed in was a spacious 3-bedroom, 2-bath with a massive kitchen (the owner said there’s even a 4th bedroom if you need it, for just a little more). “Fully furnished” does not quite describe the attention to detail and valuable extras that are provided.  Snorkeling gear (check!), boogie boards (check!), ice coolers (check!), washer/dryer (check!), as well as tons of kitchenware, a massive gas grill under the carport, and more. We saved a lot of money on gear we didn’t need to rent, and saved time not having to make that extra trip to the store for “essentials.”  A flat-screen TV, Apple TV, and a nice wi-fi setup bring this vintage Hawaiian home into the digital age.  There are some great restaurants (4-star or better on Yelp, Saigon Noodle House was one of our favorites - (Website hidden by Airbnb) just a mile away in a nearby shopping center, or in downtown Kailua.  Kailua Beach and Lanakai Beach are just a short drive away, and quickly became our favorite beaches of the trip.  We got way more for our money in Kailua, and truly felt like we had been to Oahu for the first time.\r\n\r\nBottom line: If you want to sip umbrella drinks on Wakiki Beach, with a short walk back to an overpriced, tiny condo, this is not the place for you.  But if you want to feel like you are truly living in Hawaii, and experience the island from the perspective of a multi-generational Hawaiian family (the photos are right on the walls!) – with all the modern perks you would expect, I highly recommend this property."

                "comments": "We knew from previous reviews that Joao's place was lovely, but still, it was a pleasant surprise to enter and see such a lovely apartment, just as pictured.                 "date": "2017-08-18T04:00:00.000Z",
                "listing_id": "8543198",
                "reviewer_id": "52423874",
                "reviewer_name": "John",
                "comments": "We (6 middle-aged couples) were in Villa C1 at Waikaloa Beach Villas for 14 days  - a great villa at this complex  in all respects. Loved it. We went to celebrate retirements, birthdays, relax and enjoy each others company and this complex provided us such an ideal opportunity to do so compared to the often crowded hotel resorts. This C1 villa has absolutely everything you need including heaps of beach gear in garage. We didn't want to spend $'s eating out each night and the really well appointed kitchen and BBQ allowed us to cook our own meals when we wished.  C1 is 10 metres from one of the the complexes 2 pools. Queens Market Place over road and Kings up the road, golf clubs in walking distance and ample walking opportunities. The community is compact from the Waikaloa Villas at one end to the Hilton Resort at  the other. The WBV's provide a pass to the Hilton to use their pools- we used and just well worth having a look at this complex complete with its own monorail!! We had a rental to do some day touring and beach visits. While there is a food store at Queen's its expensive so a short drive (15 mins) to the larger store at Waikoloa Village well worth it. Eat out options average at Queens and the nearby Kings Market Places, but we found Sansei Seafood, Steak and Sushi Bar at Queens superb - but you need to book. Most bars have happy hour (50% on beers and house wines from 3-6). We found beach front Lava Lava Beach Club by far the best here for ambiance, drinks and food-try the pulled pork sliders! and the marvellous sunset too and turtles came ashore  for the night. Hapuna Beach the best but need to take own chairs and umbrellas (from the garage). We did an 11 hour day trip with tour company to other side of island to see the volcanoes - much of the flora and fauna shown we have in NZ  but the lava glow/aura we saw at night was stunning. Trip was expensive but included a lunch and seated dinner - value for money ?? but we went to see the volcanoes and weren't disappointed.  Discount available if you want to sit through a Hilton presentation (no thanks).\nWe've been fortunate to travel worldly. In terms of relaxation this was the best. Two weeks without rain and 29-32 deg temps - heaven!   We're already planning a return in 2018! Just leave us a 10 day window please!"

                "comments": "We had a great week at juergens place.                 "comments": "Le logement est parfait pour 2 familles, nous étions 2 couples avec 4 enfants et l'espace était assez grand pour tout le monde et bien pensé (1 chambre en bungalow en extérieur avec douche/toilette).\nLe logement était propre (intérieur/extérieur), tout était prêt pour notre arrivée (hiver à Sydney) couettes sur les lits, bouillottes, radiateurs à disposition et la cheminée feu de bois ! génial !                 "reviewer_name": "Erik",
                "comments": "When I first booked this place it was advertised as an entire house with three bedrooms, a large kitchen, a nice dining room, washer, dryer, back yard and hot tub.                 "reviewer_name": "Jacob",
                "comments": "This house was a perfect rental for the week for me and my buddy. Both of us were from out of state (CA and FL) and attending a wedding nearby.  The location of the house was about perfect for us, being both close to where the wedding was as well as close to town and a little bit of local nightlife (we were about to walk home from Kailua in about 20-25 minutes one night after going out). Kailua is a decent city about a 5 min drive away with pretty much everything you'll need close to you (Target, Safeway, Wholefoods, shopping, restaurants, and some decent little dive bars). \r\n\r\nMy only complaint about this place was really just a simple mix up with the initial access into the property. Long story short, it took 3 hours after his initial response before his wife was able to make it over to reset it. From the moment I got there I had to wait about 3.5 hours to actually get into the house, which isn't the most fun to do when trying to get changed in clothes that are more suited for the heat and humidity (jeans and long sleeve shirt may be appropriate for the airport I departed from, but not for flying into Honolulu). So about 3.5 hours of being sweaty and miserable trying to kill time in town before being able to change.\r\n\r\nThat being said, the rest of the property was very clean, decently furnished, and the quality of the house and amenities is what I would consider to be average for the houses in the area, which is to say that yes it was a nice place. \r\n\r\nI give the house 4 stars out of 5 because of the mixup of the entry access code and long response time.                 "reviewer_id": "5754378",
                "reviewer_name": "David",
                "comments": "Royal Kuhio suite was a great affordable place to stay just outside of the over crowded streets of Waikiki but easily walking distance to everything you need. We had 3 adults, used the kitchen for breakfast half our stay and used the washer at the end of the trip so we aren't coming home with no clean clothes. On the other side ala wai river is great to walk in the morning during sunrise.\n\nThe only downsides were as such, both out of Rogers control:\nWaikiki has roaches everywhere, No avoiding them, and you will spot a few smaller ones in the kitchen early in the morning but they're small and harmless. There's no treadmill but this can easily be remedied by heading outside before sunrise and running up ala wai towards diamond head, pay the $1 walk in admission and jog up to the top of diamond head to watch the sunrise, then jog back to the hotel for bfast. (Pro-tip for diamond head, at the top go right up the endless staircase then continue up the spiral staircase to come out in a bunker and climb out onto the path to see the sun.                 "comments": "PROS\nLocation: very close to restaurants, shops, a grocery store, public transport and most importantly the beach.\n\nView: has a great view of the city (apartment is on the 34th floor). \n\nHost: the host was very helpful and responsive.                 "listing_id": "1155475",
                "reviewer_id": "2954432",
                "reviewer_name": "Jake",
                "comments": "I stayed with Jon during a Christmas reunion with my family (one couple from Seattle, one from Texas, and my wife and I visiting from Amsterdam). First, Jon's house is in an excellent location- there is plenty to do within walking distance (grocery stores, restaurants, and even the Barclay's center), plus the connection to public transport is outstanding- there are a few stops within a 5-10min walk, leaving you with tons of local / express train options. We traveled to Manhattan every day and never spent more than 30min on the train. Additionally, the house is huge and never felt small with six of us there. The kitchen is big enouch to cook a modest meal, and the dining / living rooms are perfect places for larger groups to reconnect after a day of activities. There's also two full bathrooms, so just a tiny bit of planning prevents any bathroom scheduling conflics.\n\nThe main thing that keeps this from being a perfect rental is the sleeping arrangements- there is really only one real bed suitable for two people. There's a second queen bed in the listing that can accommodate two people, but it's only a sofa-bed in the 2nd floor study (separated from the main bedroom by a curtain). The 3rd and 4th bedrooms on the 3rd floor have twin beds which, though more comfortable than the sofa-bed, will always feel like two separate beds even when pushed together. Families or groups with people desiring individual beds will be fine here (the top two bedrooms would be perfect for a few kids or friends bunking together to save money), but you if your party has more than one couple, you might consider other options.\n\nAll things considered, this property is a pretty good value- it's a huge place that can accommodate many people, and it's in a perfect location. However, if I were to return for a similar trip, I'd only consider a return visit if at least one more queen+ bed was added."

                "reviewer_name": "Philippe",
                "comments": "The house is SPACIOUS and PERFECTLY LOCATED (walking distance to the B and 4-5 lines which take you all over Manhattan in a few minutes... and more lines). Fort Greene is a also a great neighborhood itself with lots of shopping options, the park and the BAM. The house itself is very nice, arranged over three floors with a large yard on a quite street. Check in was completely painless and Jon was super responsive when we had an issue with internet.\nOverall it's a great house and a unique experience to pretend to live in such a coveted neighborhood. However, I ended up paying about 800 per nigh because it was the holiday season and I am going to write a review based on this price. \nThere are a few things that COULD BE IMPROVED though. First, I somehow convinced that this would be a house in which Jon lives but this is not his primary residence.                 "reviewer_name": "Courtney",
                "comments": "Shangri'La is a great getaway from hectic everyday lives and typical busy tourist areas.                 "reviewer_id": "2812727",
                "reviewer_name": "Dennis",
                "comments": "Shangri La is definitely a unique home but it has its drawbacks and is ideally suited for a certain type and size of family.  First the positives.  The lagoon is great for kids aged 5-10 who are new to snorkeling and its always fun for them to feed the fish everyday.  The landscaped grounds, beds, lines, bathrooms and laundry room are well appointed for this type of rental.  The property manager is very helpful as well.  Now the negatives.  First, the house has a strange layout with too many doors which makes it somewhat annoying to move around.  The two primary bedrooms are connected by a short hallway and so I would recommend against anyone hoping for privacy (like two couples).  Speaking of rooms, the unique island room is VERY exposed so whoever stays there must be comfortable with that (like a child).  The last room (called guest house) is also a ways from the master so families expecting young children to stay there, be careful.  As mentioned in some of the other reviews there are bugs here, and lots of them.  My kids were ravaged by mosquitoes and the kitchen was overrun by ants if you left even a crumb out.  You should also fully understand where the house is on the island relative to your intended primary activities.  You are far from the ideal snorkeling and water activities of Kona and the volcano crater is an hour away itself.  Lastly,  while the owner is very nice and communicative, he suffers from exaggeration.  For example, to say there are \"thousands\" of fish in the lagoon is outrageous.  And the local snorkeling is nothing like the Kona side.  And the couch shouldnt be considered a bed when its not even a pullout.  And don't think there is true \"access to the ocean\" - you can peak at it from someone's yard basically or walk a few blocks to a path.  Overall this is again a unique property and we enjoyed our stay for the most part, but we are adventurous.  We had 2 adults and 4 kids.  I wouldn't go above 4-5 ideally.  Happy to answer any questions objectively if you contact me.  "

                "reviewer_name": "Timothy",
                "comments": "Our stay included sharing the place between two couples. Everyone loved it. We would definitely stay here again as the value was great. \r\n\r\nThe view was great. We did not use the tv as we mainly used the place as a sleeping place and then took the ferry to the city. \r\n\r\nWe drove our car to the garage located on Central Avenue (next to the Staten Island Criminal Court) and walked to the ferry terminal . Ferry did take about a 30 minute ride to the city, but was a fun way to get there.\r\n\r\nThe neighborhood isn't that fancy or new, but we did feel comfortable and safe.                 "comments": "We stayed for 8 days with our 2 adult children and their spouses and our one-year old grandson.                 "comments": "Wayne and Kim were both terrific hosts. Excellent communication and great attention to detail.                 "comments": "I’m not sure I know enough positive words to fully describe how amazing Wayne, Kim, and their home was for our family vacation.                 "comments": "Our trip to Kauai was a three-generation celebration, and our party of eight included two babies - one a year old and the other eight months.                 "reviewer_id": "3659520",
                "reviewer_name": "Andrés",
                "comments": "El departamento de Ana tiene una muy buena ubicación. Es amplio, cómodo, luminoso, en especial el living. Se encuentra intermediado por una empresa de alquileres temporarios (Ipanema Flats), Ana responde las consultas rápidamente, pero el contacto directo es a través de un encargado. Al llegar, uno de los aires acondicionados no funcionaba, se lo hicimos saber al encargado que inicialmente no reconoció ese desperfecto. Le escribimos a Ana y al otro día, el aire fue reemplazado satisfactoriamente y no tuvimos más problemas. En general, el departamento se encuentra en buenas condiciones, aunque tiene detalles que podrían mejorarse: el baño se encuentra -en relación con la foto de referencia- ya algo desgastado por el uso (en el piso, el mueble y los azulejos de la bañera), sería deseable una mejor disponibilidad en cuanto a la vajilla y utensilios de cocina; una de las puertas de un dormitorio no cierra bien y en el otro, hay un arreglo en la pared que no tiene pintura. La televisión y WIFI funcionaron sin problemas (aunque en una de las fotos figura una televisión en el dormitorio y eso no es así, se encuentra en el comedor). El edificio aunque antiguo se encuentra en muy buen estado y la atención de los porteros es impecable y siempre muy solícitos. Más allá de todos estos detalles, nuestra estadía fue confortable y cumplió con el objetivo de descanso, cubriendo nuestras expectativas, en especial debido a la ubicación del departamento, a camino entre las playas de Copacabana e Ipanema, con todo tipo de negocios disponibles, en un barrio tranquilo y agradable."

                "comments": "Nous avons vraiment apprécié notre séjour chez Sonia! L'appart était mieux que sur les photos.                 "comments": "This is a nice apartment in a good location but was still our first disappointment with an airbnb.  \nCheck-in was the first problem.                 "comments": "“Wow” is probably the best word I can think to describe this incredible place. The photos just don’t do it justice.                 "reviewer_name": "Julian",
                "comments": "If you are seeking a charmingly rustic, secluded getaway to a cottage located twenty metres from a stunning protected beach; look no further.\r\n\r\nGetting to the house is a boating adventure directly from Palm Beach (either by the ferry, the friendly local boat house, or the water taxi).                 "comments": "Our host made us feel very welcome!  The location was wonderful - right on the ocean. The waves lulled us to sleep when we turned off the air in just the master bedroom.                 "reviewer_name": "Adel",
                "comments": "We spend 5 nights from 24 - 29 Aug at Mehmet's place. What was more personal, was when he cared to check up on my brother the next day and asked how was keeping. \n\nWe also had an incident when unfortunately my wife's wallet was pickpocketed, and it contained the flat keys.             {
                "_id": "352300592",
                "date": "2018-11-25T05:00:00.000Z",
                "listing_id": "24296834",
                "reviewer_id": "225104207",
                "reviewer_name": "Jean",
                "comments": "Three friends and I went to visit a friend in Istanbul for a week. We stayed in Mehmet’s flat for the 6 nights and thoroughly enjoyed it. The flat  is very spacious and clean. The furniture is modern and comfortable, including the beds. The kitchen is fully functional and allows for home cooked meals. On top of this, the flat offers several amenities that really make it good value, these include: a roof terrace two floors above, balconies and a sit down shower! \nThe flat is equally very well located with several landmarks such as the Galata tower only a short walk away. The surrounding area is buzzing and necessities such as grocery stores and shops are very close by. My friends and I walked everywhere including to the old town without it ever being painfully long. \n\nAll in all,  I would recommend this flat to anyone coming to visit Istanbul and more. Mehmet is also exceptionally available and quick to respond, which turned out very practical."
            },

                "reviewer_id": "911152",
                "reviewer_name": "Jonathan",
                "comments": "This is an excellent apartment/flat for small families or two couples.  This place is much larger then the photos make it look.  Each bedroom has a queen sized bed and there is room for a Pack N Play/Camping bed for a small child in either bedroom.  The master bedroom has it's own full bathroom.  \nThe view from the 4th floor is stunning at Sunset and it is a quiet neighborhood at night.  Parking is free out front or Isabel has 1 free parking spot in the underground parking area.  \nThere is a grocery store on the street level of the apartment building or you can walk/drive to the Jumbo which is not far away.  \nThe beach is a little far to walk to, but it can be done or a 5 minute drive will get you there.  Parking is free on either side of the main beach road.  This is where you will find restaurants, bars, many kilometers of bike/walking path, and for those with children there are play areas designed for them.  \nThe best part of this place is that it is only a 12 minute drive to parking areas where you can walk onto a bridge that will take you into the center of Porto.                 "reviewer_name": "Phil",
                "comments": "Our 9-day stay at Robert's condo at Kona Coffee Villas was a treat. The place is very clean, modern, and has a panoramic view of the ocean. The condo seems to be in a safe and friendly neighborhood, and is very quiet at night, apart from the chorus of chirping frogs at dusk.                 "comments": "Our Porto stay at Jorge/Rui’s place was positive.  The location was spectacular, close to many amenities and walkable to the city center.                 "comments": "The Ohana House was comfortable and well appointed. The website photos and information represented the house accurately.                 "comments": "We had a wonderful stay at this beautiful rainforest home. Great location - close to the volcano and a quick drive to town.                 "reviewer_name": "Monica",
                "comments": "Its a very cozy place. You can stay here like a local. This house has a plenty of rooms for a big group. The town is small and many places closed early. Make sure you make a reservation if you want to eat at the restaurant or buy groceries in Hilo or Kona.\nThis place has a gas fireplace, heaters, dehumidifiers, washer, dryer, and full kitchen."
            },
            {
                "_id": "178136348",
                "date": "2017-08-04T04:00:00.000Z",
                "listing_id": "3121854",
                "reviewer_id": "70278332",
                "reviewer_name": "Annabel",
                "comments": "This is a very comfortable place to stay. The dehumidifiers are key as the location is in the rainforest and humidity is definitely there - the carpets can have a damp feel at times but this should be expected. \nThe condiments in the fridge and cupboard were very handy as we used the outdoor propane grill one night. The gas fireplace was handy - it does get cool in the evenings even in the summer. We loved the washer/dryer as it was a good size (not like those tiny ones you see stacked in a closet in other rental units).\nWe arrived after sun down so the road was a bit dark as is the whole neighborhood. Don't expect much in the form of street lights or visible street signs. Thank goodness for GPS and smart phone maps. The free wifi was handy as our cell phone carrier signals were weak. \nThe proximity to the entrance to Volcanoes National Park cannot be beat. It gave us an early start into the park and gave us a great place to stay the night after a full day there (including watching sunset from the Jagger Museum lookout).\nWe were very happy with our stay thanks to Becky and her accommodation. Thank you!"

Ted’s Bakery is just down the highway, about a 4 min. walk as well. We enjoyed numerous meals there and the food is top quality!  Nice to have that so close. We stayed on the top level of the house. It was nice to have a personal bedroom for each of the three of us. We definitely appreciated the space. Amenities are basic but what we needed. Food cannot be left out as the ants will come. There is no A/C. It is best to not be in the house from say noon till sundown as it will be quite hot. However, opening the windows and bringing in the evening air is sufficient (we stayed the first week of November.) The occasional rain showers also helped to mediate the heat inside. Roosters begin their morning chatter around 4:30 am. Earplugs are a must if you are used to a more quiet sleeping environment. We had a few leaks in the roof on a day when the rains were heavier. We just moved the sofa out of the drip line and all was fine. We drove a lot around the island and this home was a great starting place for our day trips. Would definitely recommend this home for a stay in the North Shore."

                "reviewer_id": "10681107",
                "reviewer_name": "Jamie",
                "comments": "Tane's place is an amazing respite from typical Hawaiian tourist fare. You are located up from the belt road, so it's a bit cooler, and bugs are not at all an issue. The place ranks on the farm house side. Its layout is incredible and feels a bit like three hales combined into one. Ceiling fans keep you cool, if needed. The kitchen is ample and Tane makes sure you have enough of everything (linens, paper products, water) so that you are completely self-sufficient. He supplied us with complimentary coffee, cinnamon (both amazingly good--we bought 2 more lbs of coffee), oranges, bananas, and strawberries upon arrival. A silent but super hospitable and responsive host. Some other notes: You probably won't want to leave the screened lanai with hot tub (we didn't use the hot tub, mainly because we were fairly warm throughout our stay, but we thought about it every night); if you are a light sleeper, bring earplugs to silence out the ubiquitous frogs who sing throughout the night; drive carefully along the narrow paved road to the property--most of the people living around are locals and also are farmers.                 "reviewer_id": "37479739",
                "reviewer_name": "John",
                "comments": "Nestled on a quiet cul-de-sac in the laid-back Hawaiian town of Kailua, Tutu’s Hale delivers as a peaceful respite on the oft-overlooked windward (or east) side of Oahu.  Short story: My wife and I traveled to Oahu 10 years ago.  We stayed in a hotel on Waikiki Beach, we largely kept to Honolulu (beaches, shopping, restaurants, etc.), we spent a lot of money, and had a miserable time.  We were determined this time to really experience all that Oahu had to offer, and generally avoid the heavy tourist areas.  Instead of the traffic and headaches of Honolulu, we opted to stay in Kailua – which turned out to be a great decision.  If you are concerned that Kailua may be too far from the action of Honolulu, don’t worry.  With the Pali Highway (Route 61), Route 72, and H3, we found ourselves only a scenic 30-minute drive from downtown Honolulu, Diamond Head, Hanauma Bay, Pearl Harbor, or the junction to North Shore.  If you don’t believe me, check out these images – this is your drive every day! (Website hidden by Airbnb) \r\n\r\nThe house we stayed in was a spacious 3-bedroom, 2-bath with a massive kitchen (the owner said there’s even a 4th bedroom if you need it, for just a little more). “Fully furnished” does not quite describe the attention to detail and valuable extras that are provided.  Snorkeling gear (check!), boogie boards (check!), ice coolers (check!), washer/dryer (check!), as well as tons of kitchenware, a massive gas grill under the carport, and more. We saved a lot of money on gear we didn’t need to rent, and saved time not having to make that extra trip to the store for “essentials.”  A flat-screen TV, Apple TV, and a nice wi-fi setup bring this vintage Hawaiian home into the digital age.  There are some great restaurants (4-star or better on Yelp, Saigon Noodle House was one of our favorites - (Website hidden by Airbnb) just a mile away in a nearby shopping center, or in downtown Kailua.  Kailua Beach and Lanakai Beach are just a short drive away, and quickly became our favorite beaches of the trip.  We got way more for our money in Kailua, and truly felt like we had been to Oahu for the first time.\r\n\r\nBottom line: If you want to sip umbrella drinks on Wakiki Beach, with a short walk back to an overpriced, tiny condo, this is not the place for you.  But if you want to feel like you are truly living in Hawaii, and experience the island from the perspective of a multi-generational Hawaiian family (the photos are right on the walls!) – with all the modern perks you would expect, I highly recommend this property."

                "comments": "We knew from previous reviews that Joao's place was lovely, but still, it was a pleasant surprise to enter and see such a lovely apartment, just as pictured.
